---
applyTo: "specs/**"
---

# Specs

- Use the template in `specs/README.md`. Sections: Problem, Scope, Requirements
  (numbered, each testable), Acceptance criteria (each says how it is checked),
  Validation, Open questions.
- A new spec starts as `Status: Draft`. Only the EDM architecture owner sets
  `Approved`.
- A spec never contains implementation. It names the decisions
  (`docs/decisions/`) it depends on; a design choice that changes the
  architecture needs a new decision record first.
- Write in plain English, short sentences.
